_comment: Public exhibitions, conventions, consumer shows and fairs in Greater London,
written by hand from this file rather than templated at build time.
SCOPE. Dropped on purpose: spectator sport (football, NFL, darts, snooker,
basketball, padel, Hyrox, squash, other fitness-competition spectacles),
trade-only shows with no public day, permanent attractions and ice rinks
christmas-shows-london.md), and anything outside Greater London.
27 Sep 2026), plus follow-up checks the same day via curl against each
organiser's own site, royalparks.org.uk, and olympia.co.uk for 2027 dates
on shows whose recorded date had already passed.
dates: null means the organiser has not announced next in-window dates yet.
lastEditionDates then carries the most recent confirmed run, for the
'Dates not announced yet' table. Re-check these before the next refresh.

shows.name: Frieze London & Frieze Masters
shows.priceFrom: From about £38 for a weekend ticket (per the sister listing in things-to-do-in-london-in-october.md)
shows.notes: Two fairs at opposite ends of the park, linked by a free shuttle: Frieze London is contemporary work, Frieze Masters antiquity to the late 20th century. frieze.com itself blocks automated fetches; dates confirmed instead via The Royal Parks' own event page.

shows.name: Affordable Art Fair - Battersea Autumn
shows.notes: Private view Wed 14 Oct 5-9pm, general admission from Thu 15 Oct.

shows.name: 1-54 Contemporary African Art Fair
shows.datesNote: 15 Oct is a ticketed press and VIP preview; public days are 16-18 Oct.

shows.name: MCM Comic Con London
shows.datesNote: Only London edition currently announced within the window; MCM has not listed a second 2027 London date yet.
shows.priceFrom: From £29 one-day entry; weekend and both VIP tiers already sold out
shows.size: Billed by the organiser as the UK's biggest Comic Con
shows.sellsOut: Yes - Weekend tickets and both VIP tiers were sold out more than a month before the show
shows.notes: EGX (RX's sister gaming show) appears to have been folded into MCM for London - egx.net now lists only MCM London and MCM Birmingham.

shows.name: AnimeCon London
shows.notes: Organiser: Oakham Group. Billed as the UK's biggest anime/manga convention.

shows.name: Musical Con

shows.size: Four stages, 47+ speakers; livestreamed for ticket holders
shows.notes: Full details and speaker list in science-events-london.md and things-to-do-in-london-in-october.md.
